2609.31169.title: Improving Visual Sensitivity of LLMs on Multimodal Machine Translation with Metric-based Loss Weighting
2609.31169.paper_summary: Multimodal Machine Translation aims to incorporate additional signal from non-textual modalities to improve translations by resolving ambiguities. While models, through multimodal fusion, are able to accept images related to the source text, they can ignore this information. Therefore, increasing their visual sensitivity remains an active research area. In this work, we introduce a training method, Metric-based Loss Weighting, that improves visual grounding of translations by increasing the loss function for tokens that benefit from the accompanying image. We identify these tokens using the Point-wise Cross-mutual Information (PCXMI) metric, which compares the model's output probabilities with and without visual context. We introduce a Congruency-based PCXMI metric and experimentally show that both metrics working in combination yield the best results. We evaluate our method by fine-tuning three pretrained Multimodal Large Language Models on the task of Image-guided Machine Translation for three language directions. Metric-based Loss Weighting outperforms other tested methods on the CoMMuTE contrastive dataset, improving accuracy by up to more than 7 percentage points compared to standard fine-tuning, while maintaining strong general translation performance.
2609.31169.paper_summary_zh: 多模態機器翻譯旨在通過解決歧義，整合來自非文本模態的額外信號以改善翻譯。雖然模型通過多模態融合能夠接受與源文本相關的圖像，但它們可能會忽略這些信息。因此，提高它們的視覺敏感性仍然是一個活躍的研究領域。在本研究中，我們提出了一種訓練方法，基於度量的損失加權，通過增加受益於伴隨圖像的標記的損失函數來改善翻譯的視覺基礎。我們使用逐點交叉互信息（PCXMI）度量來識別這些標記，該度量比較模型在有視覺上下文和無視覺上下文下的輸出概率。我們引入了一種基於一致性的PCXMI度量，並實驗性地顯示這兩種度量的組合能產生最佳結果。我們通過對三個預訓練的多模態大型語言模型進行微調，來評估我們的方法，任務為圖像引導的機器翻譯，涵蓋三個語言方向。基於度量的損失加權在CoMMuTE對比數據集上的表現優於其他測試方法，準確率比標準微調提高了超過7個百分點，同時保持強大的通用翻譯性能。
